    GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∨ errStopped err ∗ nodeStopped n γ N ∨ ctxErr cd err)

    : w64) (Q : List LogEntry → IProp GF) (l' : List LogEntry) (E : CoPset) : ↑N ⊆ E → uint.nat idx

theorem node.wp_readyRecv [package_sem : Assumptions] (n ch : Loc) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id
    : w64) (st : NodeDriverState) : st.handling = none → ⊢ ∀ Φ, isReadyChan n γ N ch ∗ isNode n γ N
    id ∗ nodeDriver n γ N st -∗ (▷ ∀ rd, (∃ ce es h L, committedEntriesAt rd.CommittedEntries'
    st.delivered.length ce ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ (st.delivered ++ ce) ∗ (∃ rs, readStatesPts
    rd.ReadStates' rs ∗ [∗list] s ∈ rs, readStateOk γ N s.RequestCtx' s.Index') ∗ readyRest γ N id
    rd st ce es h L ∗ nodeDriver n γ N (match L with | none => { storage := st.storage, delivered :=
    st.delivered ++ ce, hardState := phsNext st.hardState h, handling := some (es, none) } | some l
    => { storage := st.storage, delivered := strip l.dlv, hardState := phsNext st.hardState h,
    handling := some (es, some l) })) -∗ Φ (intoVal rd, intoVal true)) -∗ WP ((chan.receive
    Ready.ty) (intoVal ch)) {{ Φ }}

theorem readyRest_indices [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (rd :
    Ready) (st : NodeDriverState) (ce : List LogEntry) (es : List EntryM) (h : HardStateM) (L :
    Option SnapLoan) : readyRest γ N id rd st ce es h L ⊢ ⌜∀ (e0 : EntryM), es.head? = some e0 → ∀
    (j : Nat) (e : EntryM), es[j]? = some e → uint.nat e.Index' = uint.nat e0.Index' + j⌝ ∗
    readyRest γ N id rd st ce es h L

def (sealed) ownReadCtxs (γ : Cluster) (U : GSet (List w8)) : IProp GF

def readyRest (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (rd : Ready) (st : NodeDriverState) (ce :
    List LogEntry) (es : List EntryM) (h : HardStateM) (L : Option SnapLoan) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ms,
      entsRO rd.Entries' es ∗
        ownSlice rd.Messages' (List.map QMsg.loc ms) (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          ([∗list] q ∈ ms, iprop(msgOwn q.loc (readyDq q.st) q.st ∗ sentMsg γ N id q.st ∗ msgCredits γ N q.st)) ∗
            hsOpt rd.HardState' h ∗
              softStateRO rd.SoftState' ∗
                ⌜∃ Lx,
                      Lx < 2 ^ 64 ∧
                        (∀ (e0 : EntryM), es.head? = some e0 → uint.Z e0.Index' + ↑es.length ≤ Lx + 1) ∧
                          ↑(st.delivered ++ ce).length ≤ Lx ∧ Lx < ↑(receiptBound GF) + ↑γ.bootLen⌝ ∗
                  readySnap γ N id rd st ce es L)

theorem isReadyChan_recvAu [package_sem : Assumptions] (n ch : Loc) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace)
    (id : w64) (st : NodeDriverState) (Φ : Ready → Bool → IProp GF) : st.handling = none → ⊢
    isReadyChan n γ N ch -∗ isNode n γ N id -∗ nodeDriver n γ N st -∗ ∃ γc, isChan ch γc Ready ∗ (£
    1 ∗ £ 1 -∗ (▷ ∀ rd, (∃ ce es h L, committedEntriesAt rd.CommittedEntries' st.delivered.length ce
    ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ (st.delivered ++ ce) ∗ (∃ rs, readStatesPts rd.ReadStates' rs ∗ [∗list] s ∈
    rs, readStateOk γ N s.RequestCtx' s.Index') ∗ readyRest γ N id rd st ce es h L ∗ nodeDriver n γ
    N (match L with | none => { storage := st.storage, delivered := st.delivered ++ ce, hardState :=
    phsNext st.hardState h, handling := some (es, none) } | some l => { storage := st.storage,
    delivered := strip l.dlv, hardState := phsNext st.hardState h, handling := some (es, some l) }))
    -∗ Φ rd true) -∗ recvAu γc Ready Φ)

theorem sentMsg_replaceSnapshot [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (src :
    w64) (st : MsgSt) (sv sv' : SnapshotM) (c : w64) (l : List LogEntry) (E : CoPset) : ↑N ⊆ E →
    st.msg.Type' = MsgSnap → st.snap = some sv → uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' ≤ uint.Z
    sv'.Metadata'.Index' → uint.Z sv'.Metadata'.Index' ≤ uint.Z c → l.length = uint.nat
    sv'.Metadata'.Index' → Option.map LogEntry.term l.getLast? = some sv'.Metadata'.Term' → ⊢
    sentMsg γ N src st -∗ committedAtTerm γ N st.msg.Term' c -∗ isCommittedLogLb γ l -∗ snapshotCert
    γ N (snapTrip sv' sv'.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists) ={E}=∗ sentMsg γ N src { msg := st.msg, ents
    := st.ents, snap := some sv', ctx := st.ctx, resps := st.resps }

    NodeDriverState) (ce : List LogEntry) (es : List EntryM) (h : HardStateM) (L : Option SnapLoan)
    : readyFits γ N ∗ readyRest γ N id rd st ce es h L ⊢ readyRest γ N id rd st ce es h L ∗ ⌜∀ (e0 :
    EntryM), es.head? = some e0 → uint.Z e0.Index' + ↑es.length ≤ 2 ^ 61⌝

    : Ready) (st : NodeDriverState) (ce : List LogEntry) (es : List EntryM) (h : HardStateM) :
    readyRest γ N id rd st ce es h none ⊢ ⌜∀ (e0 : EntryM), es.head? = some e0 → ∀ (j : Nat) (e :
    LogEntry), ce[j]? = some e → uint.nat e0.Index' ≤ st.delivered.length + 1 + j → Option.map

    N id rd st ce es h none

theorem readCtx_commit_after (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (U : GSet (List w8)) (c : List w8) (Q :
    List LogEntry → IProp GF) (l0 : List LogEntry) : ¬c ∈ U → ownReadCtxs γ U ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ
    l0 ∗ □ AU <{ ∃∃ ops, ownCommittedOps γ ops }> @ ⊤ \ ↑N, ∅ <{ ownCommittedOps γ ops, COMM □ Q ops
    }> ⊢ |==> (ownReadCtxs γ (insert c U) ∗ isReadCtx γ N c Q ∗ readCtxAfter γ N c l0)

    (src : w64) (st : MsgSt) : st.msg.To' = id → sentMsg γ N src st ∗ msgPtsC ml (DFrac.own 1)
    (DFrac.own 1) true { msg := st.msg, ents := st.ents, snap := st.snap, ctx := st.ctx, resps := []
    } ∗ msgCredits γ N st ⊢ |==> stepIn γ N id ml

    LogEntry → IProp GF) : ¬c ∈ U → ownReadCtxs γ U ∗ □ AU <{ ∃∃ ops, ownCommittedOps γ ops }> @ ⊤ \

    cm.nodeId ≠ W64 0 → cm.nodeId ∈ vs → GMap.delete cm.nodeId vs ≠ ∅ → (Membership.simple vs).Valid
    → Membership.applyChange (ConfChangeIM.v1 cm) (Membership.simple vs) = some (Membership.simple
    (GMap.delete cm.nodeId vs))

    MsgSt) : sentMsg γ N src st ⊢ ⌜SentMsgShape st ∧ (st.msg.Type' = MsgSnap → ∃ sv, st.snap = some
    sv ∧ uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' < 2 ^ 61)⌝

def readySnap (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (rd : Ready) (st : NodeDriverState) (ce :
    List LogEntry) (es : List EntryM) : Option SnapLoan → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none =>
    iprop(⌜rd.Snapshot' = null⌝ ∗
        appendRight st.storage es ∗
          ceFrozen st.storage st.delivered.length (LogEntry.toEntries ce st.delivered.length) es ∗
            ⌜∀ (e0 : EntryM),
                es.head? = some e0 →
                  (∀ (j : Nat) (e : EntryM), es[j]? = some e → uint.nat e.Index' = uint.nat e0.Index' + j) ∧
                    ∀ (j : Nat) (e : LogEntry),
                      ce[j]? = some e →
                        uint.nat e0.Index' ≤ st.delivered.length + 1 + j →
                          Option.map LogEntry.ofEntryM es[st.delivered.length + 1 + j - uint.nat e0.Index']? = some e⌝)
  | some l =>
    iprop(⌜l.dlv = LogEntry.toEntries (strip l.dlv) 0 ∧
            l.ptr = rd.Snapshot' ∧
              ce = [] ∧
                st.delivered <+: strip l.dlv ∧
                  st.delivered.length < l.dlv.length ∧
                    l.dlv.length = uint.nat l.snap.Metadata'.Index' ∧
                      0 < uint.Z l.snap.Metadata'.Index' ∧
                        uint.Z l.snap.Metadata'.Index' < 2 ^ 61 ∧
                          uint.Z l.fl ≤ uint.Z l.snap.Metadata'.Index' ∧ LogIndicesOk (snapId l.snap) es⌝ ∗
        ownSnapS l.ptr (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) l.snap ∗
          isCommittedLogLb γ (strip l.dlv) ∗
            snapshotCert γ N (snapTrip l.snap l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists) ∗
              (∃ k old,
                  ⌜k ≤ uint.nat l.snap.Metadata'.Index'⌝ ∗
                    storLog st.storage k (DFrac.own 1) old ∗ storEnd st.storage (k + old.length)) ∗
                snapGiven γ id (uint.nat l.snap.Metadata'.Index'))
